source_title: The 2.6lb Lenovo Yoga 7X Ultra-Slim Laptop With OLED Display and Snapdragon X2 Elite CPU Drops to $950
source_excerpt:
The ultimate ultra-portable laptop for students and professionals on the move.
Don't miss out on these excellent Black Friday worthy deals on one of the best ultra-portable laptops for both students and remote working professionals. For a limited time, Best Buy is offering the Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x 14" Laptop , equipped with a 14" OLED display and the newest Snapdragon X2 Elite processor, all while weighing less than 2.6 pounds, for just $949.99 with free shipping after $700 in instant savings. This configuration has 16GB of storage. Alternatively you can get upgraded 32GB of storage for $1,149.99 with free shipping at Lenovo direct.
Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x 14" Snapdragon X2 Elite Laptop From $950
Lenovo Yoga Slim 7X 14" OLED Snapdragon X2 Elite X2E-80-100 Ultra-Portable Laptop (16GB/1TB)
Lenovo Yoga Slim 7X 14" OLED Snapdragon X2 Elite X2E-80-100 Ultra-Portable Laptop (32GB/1TB)
The Yoga Slim 7X is a truly portable laptop, weighing in at a mere 2.6 pounds for a 14" footprint and measuring only 0.5" thin. It boasts premium materials, such as a unibody aluminum chassis and a stunning 14" 1920x1200 OLED display. This particular configuration is equipped with a Snapdragon X2 Elite X2E-80-100 CPU, 16GB or 32GB of LPDDR5X-9523MT/s memory, and a 1TB SSD. Connectivity options include Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4, and three USB-C 40Gbps ports.
The Snapdragon X2 Elite processor is new for 2026
The Snapdragon X2 Elite (X2E-80-100) was released in April of 2026. This is a 12-core Qualcomm ARM-based laptop CPU designed to run Windows 11 with Copilot+. It's a capable processor for your every day productivity and multimedia tasks that compares roughly in performance to an Intel Core Ultra 7 H-series CPU. The processor is also equipped with Adreno X2 onboard graphics, which does a serviceable job of playing entry level games but certainly not at the same level as a discrete graphics card TL;DR don't get this laptop for enthusiast gaming needs.
For such a lightweight laptop built with premium materials, an OLED display and current generation components, all in an ultra-light sub 3 pound platform, the asking price of $950 is a steal. Let's also not forget just how expensive DDR5 memory is nowadays, and the $1,150 laptop is generously equipped with 32GB of it.
Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.
